description:
Over the years by far the most common question we get asked is “when are you coming out with a suspension model?” We are pleased to introduce our newest model- The Trident Trekker with a hidden adjustable rear suspension.

Trekkers are available in either a 20” Rear Wheel or a 26” Rear Wheel model. Along with a powder coated Chro- Moly frame, the Trekker series will have some exciting new features. First of course is the adjustable suspension in the frame. By putting the suspension in the frame we were able to shorten up the rear end a bit, and it made a HUGE difference in both handling and traction when compared to the traditional suspension systems we tested. Other features include a Flat Wheel Fold and Adjustable Handlebars. Trekker models will come equipped with our signature Mesh Seat with 4 adjustable angles and 3 height positions.However for those that would prefer a Hardshell Seat with a Ventisit type pad and Neckrest, we can also accommodate you- there is a $75.00 charge for the substitution. X Seam Ranges have also been increased – the Trekker will accommodate riders with X Seams from 34 ¼ (with optional 152 mm crankarms and Z Bars) to 47 ¼” (900mm-1200mm). We can also accommodate even larger X Seams- up to 51″ with an optional XL Boom ($50 additional) . Rounding out the features are Avid BB7 Disc Brakes with locking Parking Brake Levers, a High End Forged Crankset with CNC Machined Rings with an Integrated Bottom Bracket, a double Idler System (single idler on Trekker 26) which is as nice as anything any manufacturer makes, and finally a new CNC Machined Rear Derailleur – the Microshift Marvo XE paired with the TS-B10 Microshift Bar End Shifters .Schwalbe Trykers/Marathon Racer Tires are standard.

We also offer the Fat Trekker as well as The E Fat Trekker with 20 x 4″ Front Wheels and 26 x 4 Rear Wheel. Lastly the Fat Trekker Quad is now available- it has 2wd, and 2 way rear suspension (up and down and lateral). It is equipped with an Enviolo Nuvinci TR380 which gives it an unbelievable gear inch range of 10.4- 79.2 ! It is also available as the E Fat Trekker Quad which adds a TS Motors 500W 48V Mid Drive Motor and a 14AH Battery. The E Fat Trekker Quad is 98% Assembled. The shipping weight of the Quad is 125 Lbs (including the pallet)

We now offer a Quad Conversion Kit for your Non Electric Fat Trekker. Includes everything you need to convert your Fat Trekker into a Quad!

New for 2024- In response to many requests- we are offering the E Trekker 26 . The E Trekker 26 uses a Tong Sheng 48V 500 watt Mid Drive Motor with 5 assist levels and a Throttle override along with a 48v 14AH Rack Mounted Battery. One other notable improvement on the E Trekker 26 is a thru axle rear wheel. The E Trekker is 10 speed .

Lastly- Trekker models (except Fat Trekkers) come with all the “extras” at no charge- a Rear Rack, Rear Lights, a full set of 3 Fenders, a mirror, an accessory mount, and a safety flag are all included in the price! Fat Trekkers come with a Rear Rack, pedals and a flag. See how much other manufacturers charge for all of that!

Trekker Trikes are shipped to you in 1 box- it is 90% assembled. You also always have the option of picking up a fully assembled trike in Lincolnton, NC- about 30 miles NW of Charlotte, NC.

Both Trekker 20 Models and Trekker 26 Models are available in either Wasabi Green . Wolfpack Red or Carolina Blue.

Shipping Added to Total Price in Cart
